decisions.rationale: Issue #164 defines SigLIP 2 as the standard semantic-embedding candidate; adoption remains pending benchmark evidence.
Kept as the speed-oriented comparison candidate for semantic embedding.

Current NeoHorse 4B abliterated GGUF candidate. The repository is very new, so the checked-in profile is exploratory until an immutable revision, exact GGUF filename/size and SHA-256 are pinned from a controlled run.

Japanese-focused Heretic candidate. Upstream llama.cpp v0.4.1 added native Spark2.5 support (#27868), so the controlled run uses the same pinned b10964 CPU runtime family as the other prompt candidates. Adoption still requires immutable model revision and artifact SHA-256 evidence.
Qwen3.5-4B abliterated upstream-llama.cpp control used to separate prompt quality/refusal effects from NeoHorse/Spark fine-tuning. Adoption requires immutable revision and artifact SHA-256 evidence.

Reproducible Qwen3.5-4B base-lineage control. TheStageAI publishes an exact upstream base revision, release manifest and quantization quality measurements; the M tier is used as the compact instruction-following reference. Adoption evidence still requires pinning this GGUF repository revision and artifact SHA-256.
Pinned benchmark candidate with direct general, character and rating outputs. Adoption is pending controlled lumine-ai-core-v2 evidence.
Pinned newer-character-focused benchmark candidate. The public ONNX export exposes general and character tags but no direct rating category; adoption is pending controlled lumine-ai-core-v2 evidence.
Task-specialized caption/OCR quality reference for Lightweight Vision. Adoption is pending controlled private-fixture evidence.
Small Apache-2.0 llama.cpp multimodal candidate with pinned Q8 model and mmproj; attractive for product integration if quality/CPU results are adequate.
Official Qwen3-VL 2B GGUF baseline. Adoption is pending controlled Advanced Vision fixture evidence.
Abliterated Qwen3-VL 2B candidate used to directly measure lawful adult-only refusal/weakening behavior and any quality trade-off versus the official model.
Independent 2B-class llama.cpp candidate for deep image understanding and Japanese/multi-image comparison.
Official ggml 2.2B-class comparison candidate with multi-image-oriented model lineage; adoption pending Lumine-specific evidence.
Current small official GGUF candidate with llama.cpp support; measured against the same deep/multi-image/Japanese/OCR/adult-only fixtures before adoption.
Exploratory Heretic candidate for direct refusal/quality comparison. Immutable revision and model/mmproj SHA-256 must be recorded before its result may be used as adoption evidence.
Official Apache-2.0 4B-class llama.cpp candidate. Included as an upper-cost comparison point to measure whether materially better Advanced Vision quality justifies its larger CPU/RAM/disk footprint.

Current quality-focused PixAI candidate with May 2026 cutoff, 30,877 tags and direct rating output. Benchmark through the pinned upstream Transformers custom pipeline; adoption is blocked until controlled Lumine evidence and explicit redistribution/license status are both available.

Wide-vocabulary ONNX comparison candidate with general/character/rating outputs. GPL-3.0 and the larger runtime/model footprint are explicit adoption trade-offs; controlled Lumine evidence is still required.
